Method of Attack: Injected obfuscated JavaScript code stealing payment card details at checkout, triggered by keywords associated with payment pages, sending stolen data to opendoorcdn[.]com
Impacted Systems: Websites EuroTickets2020.com and OlympicTickets2020.com ticket reseller sites
Attack Vector: Compromise of legitimate Slippry library file slippry.min.js on affected websites
Indicators of Compromise: Presence on olympictickets2020.com and eurotickets2020.com domains
